kv20.6:2.5: "Idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi vijjā udapādi paññā udapādi āloko udapādi,
kv20.6:2.6: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pariññeyyan ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.8: idaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccan ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.9: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.11: idaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccan ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.12: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ sacchikātabban ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.14: idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccan ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.15: taṃ kho pan' idaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ bhāvetabban ti me Bhikkhave --pe--
kv20.6:2.16: bhāvitan ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi --pe--
kv20.6:2.20: Tena hi dvādasavatthukaṃ ñāṇaṃ lokuttaran ti.
kv20.6:3.1: Mātughātako ānantariko, Pitughātako ānantariko, Arahantaghātako ānantariko, Ruhiruppādako ānantariko, Saṃghabhedako ānantariko, N' atthi puthujjanassa ñāṇaṃ, N' atthi nirayesu nirayapālā, Atthi devesu tiracchānagatā, Pañcaṅgiko maggo, dvādasavatthukaṃ ñāṇaṃ lokuttaran ti.
kv20.6:4.1: Niggaho, puññasaṃcayo, aṭṭhāsi, atītena ca mātughātako ti. 1.
